name: Jarupon!
source:
Match three manly figures to unlock more. 
Jarupon! - an original easy-to-play game with loads of extras. 
Even a bonus game is included!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069192.html] DLsite English[/url]]

匹配三个男子形象即可解锁更多内容。《Jarupon!》是一款原创、简单易玩的游戏，附带大量额外内容，甚至还有奖励游戏！？
